title: Fleet Monitoring With Multi-Resolution Metrics In The Dashboard
description: Complete monitoring of the fleet across all workers: CPU, memory, disk, compilation tasks, graph reads, cache hits (local and remote), remote execution, readiness. Multi-resolution sampling: dense recent samples, progressively squashed older windows (tiered downsampling). Minimal overhead, cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows), zero-touch on every worker, aggregated across the fleet via the shared store, visualized in the repo dashboard TUI. Fully end to end. Related fleet ticket: 26/11/13 FLEET-ONE-MACHINE-SHARED-HOT-CACHE-AND-REMOTE-EXECUTION.
summary: Fleet monitoring end to end: schema-first 69-metric en/de catalogue (origin/fleet scope, per-platform support), multi-resolution RRD-style rings (1 s → 1 h tiers, exact folds, clipped partial buckets, TS writer/reader + Rust reader + golden vectors + Python oracle), collector inside the readiness service (0.11–0.25 % core, ~2.8 KB/s publication) live on 15/16 origins across macOS/Linux/Windows, persisted cumulative cache/scheduler counters and local hit counters, store hygiene, TUI chart widgets and a Fleet window in repo dashboard (overview, totals, zoom 5 min–90 d, drill-down, n/a cells, live-store headless render). Details in summary.md and result-M1..M8.md.
